source: Official AliMeeting Eval (SLR119), original archive, not a third-party mirror
curation_basis: Read all headset opening human transcript segments, identify session topics, reserve two complete original sessions, then fixed-seed general selection. No application result inspected.
casual_definition: Verified unprompted casual chat, not merely everyday subject matter in a recorded discussion. No Eval session can be certified unprompted from the supplied corpus documentation and transcripts, so the conservative verified-casual proportion is zero. Everyday-topic discussion is prioritized among the available meeting material.
reference_limits: Human lexical transcripts and speaker labels. Existing punctuation is preserved; a terminal full stop is added only where absent. Word times and internal pauses are automatic forced-alignment estimates, not independently listening-confirmed. A human listening spot-check remains necessary before benchmark freeze.
